note: Authored inventory of the SWSE vehicle weapon ecosystem (Complete Weapon Ecosystem Addendum). Source statements are paraphrased from the committed sourcebook text; every non-trivial status in the generated readiness matrix is COMPUTED from code and data, and a claim of tested behaviour must name a test file that exists. A row is never counted fully operational while a blocker remains or while LIVE_VERIFIED is false.

RANGE_BAND_NOT_AUTOMATED.text: No code resolves the attacker-target distance to a Table 10-2 range band for vehicle weapons: the attack reads a caller-supplied rangeBand (none supplied = no range modifier). data/vehicle-weapon-ranges.json holds the table; RangeEngine.getVehicleBand has no caller.

CONFIGURATION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: The configuration/modification row is SOURCE_VERIFIED only: no certified effect, no Shipyard installation, no attack-time behaviour.

AUTOFIRE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Vehicle autofire (swift-action mode switch, -5 attack, area attack that resolves as a single target at starship scale) has no implementation; stock groups printing autofire are refused as unmodeled.

LAUNCHER_AND_AMMUNITION_NOT_INSTALLABLE.text: Launchers and their ammunition have no certified effect: the Shipyard cannot sell or install them. The finite-ammunition ledger and lock-on projectile engine exist (P6C-3C/3D) and are tested on synthetic fixtures only.

NO_COMPLETE_STOCK_LAUNCHER_FAMILY.text: No published firing group carries a verified single launcher, so no stock launcher group is armed; 18 groups wait for a GM-certified launcher allocation.

MISS_DAMAGE_OF_STARSHIP_SCALE_AREA_UNRUL.text: Core Area Attacks say creatures you miss take half damage, and the Scale rule says area attacks resolve as attacks on a single target at starship scale; whether the single target still takes half damage on a miss is not stated. Register V-P6C-07. Implemented behaviour: a miss deals no damage.

SOURCE_ROW_NOT_RECONCILED.text: The catalog row has no printed table row: its numbers came from vehicle statblocks. It cannot be priced or installed until a printed source is reconciled.

STATBLOCK_EQUIPMENT_ONLY.text: Appears only inside vehicle statblocks (no weapon-systems entry in a sourcebook): not a purchasable component.

TRACTOR_BEAM_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Attack vs Reflex, opposed grapple checks, grabbed/held/pulled state, escape and range-break (Core, Tractor Beams) have no vehicle implementation; stock tractor-beam groups are refused.

GRAVITY_WELL_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Area placement (4x4 starship squares, attack vs Reflex 10), persistent hyperspace interdiction field and its effect on hyperdrive activation have no implementation.

MINES_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Swift-action deployment, persistent mine placement, Stealth/Perception/Use Computer detection, IFF and command detonation, and the entering-ship area attack have no implementation.

ION_BOMB_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Atmosphere-only restriction, -5 attack, square beneath the ship, 10-square area ion field and the four-bomb rack are not implemented (ion bomb groups refused).

SHIELDBUSTER_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Half damage against anything but shields, and a 10-point (not 5) shield-rating loss when the attack exceeds SR, are not implemented.

POINT_DEFENSE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: The point-defense modification (+4,000 credits per weapon, 0 EP, eligible weapons only, Table 10-2 point-defense ranges) is not an installable modification. The capital-ship penalty already has a point-defense exemption input; nothing sets it.

SPECIAL_WEAPON_NOT_INDIVIDUALLY_VERIFIED.text: Source-specific mechanics need individual verification and implementation.

BURST_FIRE_VEHICLE_APPLICABILITY_UNRULED.text: Burst Fire is a feat (Core: Strength 13, Weapon Proficiency (heavy weapons); -5 attack, +2 dice, five shots). Whether a gunner's feat applies to a vehicle weapon is not stated. Register V-P6C-08.

AUTOBLASTER_AUTOFIRE_UNSTATED.text: The autoblaster is printed with cost x2 and availability Restricted and described only as a higher cyclic rate; whether it has an autofire setting (and what else changes) is not stated. Register V-P6C-09.

ENHANCEMENT_STACKING_UNRULED.text: Stacking of double/quad/fire-linked/enhancement damage dice on one weapon is not stated; no combination rule is implemented. Register V-P6C-10.

CAPACITY_EXPANSION_DEFERRED.text: Extra launcher capacity (+20% / +25% cost per additional unit up to the printed maximum) is recorded but not usable: whether added capacity costs emplacement points and which cost the percentage applies to is unresolved. Register V-P6A-03.

RELOAD_ACTION_UNRULED.text: Bought ammunition arrives in the launcher's reserve; moving it into the launcher is a GM operation (no reload action or cost is invented from personal launchers). Register V-P6C-06.

OPTIONAL_LINK_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.text: Swift-action link toggle (extra damage and ammunition use apply only while linked) is not implemented.

rows.name: Laser cannons: light, medium, heavy
established: Table 3-5: 3d10x2 / 4d10x2 / 5d10x2; 1 / 1 / 2 EP; Licensed / Restricted / Military; 1,500 / 4,000 / 6,000 credits.

Laser cannons are the most common starship weapons, carried by starfighters and transports as primary armament and by capital ships as point-defense weapons; better range than blaster cannons, somewhat more expensive.
Damage = weapon dice x printed multiplier (Core, Vehicle Combat: Damage).

rows.name: Blaster cannons: light, medium, heavy
established: Table 3-5: 3d10x2 / 4d10x2 / 5d10x2; 1 / 1 / 2 EP; Licensed / Restricted / Military; 1,200 / 2,500 / 5,500 credits.
Blasters are less expensive than lasers but have a more limited range (Table 10-2: shorter bands than laser cannons).

rows.name: Autoblaster (modification of a single-mounted blaster cannon)
established: Table 3-5: no damage printed; +0 EP; Restricted; cost x2.
Blaster cannons can be designed with a higher cyclic firing rate if they have sufficient cooling; only single-mounted blasters are generally made into autoblasters.

rows.name: Turbolasers: light, medium, heavy
established: Table 3-5: 3d10x5 / 5d10x5 / 7d10x5; 2 / 5 / 10 EP; Military; 5,000 / 10,000 / 20,000 credits; Colossal or larger starships only.
All but the smallest turbolasers cannot autofire even in double, quad or fire-linked configurations.
Capital weapons take the Core -20 against targets smaller than Colossal (existing capital-ship penalty authority).

rows.name: Ion cannons: light, medium, heavy
established: Table 3-5: 3d10x2 / 5d10x2 / 3d10x5 ion; 1 / 2 / 5 EP; Licensed / Restricted / Military; 2,000 / 3,000 / 6,000 credits; heavy: Colossal or larger only.
Ion cannons deal ion damage (Core ch. 9). All but the smallest cannot autofire, even in double, quad or fire-linked configurations.
Ion damage lifecycle on the existing damage authorities: V-P6C-04/05 (project interpretation, decision matrix).

rows.name: Hapan triple ion cannon
established: Table 3-5: 5d10x5 ion; 3 EP; Illegal; 12,000 credits; Colossal or larger only.

Acts like a point-defense weapon (point-defense ranges, no penalty against ships smaller than Colossal), is capable of autofire mode, may not make starship-scale area attacks. Illegal outside the Hapan Consortium until the New Jedi Order era; the Hapans do not sell them to outsiders.

rows.name: Mass-driver cannons and rail cannons

sources.section: Republic Vehicles: Weapon Systems (Mass-Driver Cannon, Rail Cannon)

established: Mass-driver and rail cannons can only be mounted on vehicles of Gargantuan size or larger because of their recoil.
No table row prints their damage, EP or cost: the catalog numbers come from vehicle statblocks.
rows.nextSlice: WE-source reconciliation, then the plain-damage path

rows.name: Proton torpedoes and launcher
established: Table 3-5: torpedo 9d10x2, 0 EP, Military, 800 credits; launcher 1 EP, Military, 2,500 credits.
4-square splash radius. A standard launcher holds three torpedoes; additional capacity costs +25% per additional torpedo up to sixteen.
Aimed launch that misses: one follow-up next turn at the same bonus -5, no action; Reflex Defense 30, 10 hit points; second miss self-destructs (Core).
rows.nextSlice: WE-L1 done (aftermarket launcher, ammunition purchase, reload, fire, lock-on, removal); stock launcher groups wait for verified launcher counts

rows.name: Concussion missiles and launchers: light, medium, heavy
established: Table 3-5: missiles 7d10x2 / 9d10x2 / 9d10x5 (heavy: Colossal or larger), 500 / 750 / 2,000 credits; launchers 2 / 5 / 20 EP, 2,000 / 3,500 / 30,000 credits.
4-square splash radius. Launcher capacity: light 6, medium 16, heavy 30; additional capacity +20% per missile up to double.
rows.nextSlice: WE-L1 done (aftermarket launcher, ammunition purchase, reload, fire, lock-on, removal); stock launcher groups wait for verified launcher counts

rows.name: Armor-piercing concussion missiles
established: Penetration 10 (ignores the first 10 points of DR or SR) at a -5 penalty on attack rolls with the weapon.
No catalog row exists (recorded as a missing canonical component, sotg-concussion-missile-armor-piercing).
rows.nextSlice: after launchers; needs a catalog row

rows.name: Shieldbuster torpedoes and launcher
established: Table 3-5: torpedo 10d10x2, 0 EP, Military, 1,000 credits; launcher 3 EP, Military, 10,000 credits; Table 3-5 prints its own range row (character scale long band 2,251-4,000; starship 0-3 / 4-6 / 7-15 / 16-30).
Against anything but shields, shieldbusters deal half damage. If an attack exceeds the target's SR, the target loses 10 points of SR (not the normal 5); shields recharge normally.
A standard launcher holds four torpedoes, up to eight at +25% per additional torpedo.

rows.name: Space mines and mine launchers
established: Table 3-5: mines 7d10x2 / 9d10x2 / 6d10x5 (heavy takes the -20 against targets smaller than Colossal), launcher 2 EP 5,000 credits, heavy launcher 4 EP (Colossal or larger).

A mine is deployed as a swift action at any point along the ship's movement path; any ship entering the square detonates it (area attack vs Reflex of all ships there: full damage on a hit, half on a miss). IFF-immune and command-detonated variants exist.
Stealth +5 (DC to notice); the pilot may make a Perception check as a reaction, and a system operator a Use Computer check.
Attack bonuses +5 / +10 / +5; launchers hold six mines, up to twelve at +25% per additional mine.

rows.name: Ion bombs and bomb racks
established: Table 3-5: bomb 5d10 ion, 500 credits; rack 1 EP, Military, 1,000 credits.
Usable only in an atmosphere; attacks take a -5 penalty; may target the square directly beneath the ship; on impact a 10-square radius ion field deals 5d10 ion damage; a rack holds up to four bombs.

rows.name: Tractor beams
established: Table 3-5: Special; 10 EP; Licensed; 10,000 credits. Considered a nonstandard modification for space transports and starfighters.
Core: instead of damaging hit points, a tractor beam prevents a vehicle from escaping. The attack hits on equal or exceeding Reflex; on a hit, make an opposed grapple check; a win grabs the target.

A grabbed target of the beam vehicle's size or smaller cannot move and loses its Dexterity bonus to Reflex; each round another opposed grapple check; a win pulls the target up to 10 squares (1 at starship scale) or holds it; a loss frees it; leaving range breaks the hold.

rows.name: Gravity well projectors
established: Table 3-5: Special; 5 EP; Military; 50,000 credits; Colossal or larger only; starship range 0-10 squares.

Not a damage weapon: the operator chooses a 4x4-square (starship scale) area in range and attacks Reflex Defense 10; on a success the area becomes a hyperspace interdiction field; a starship that starts its turn in a covered square may not activate its hyperdrive that turn.

rows.name: Docking guns
established: Table 3-5: damage by weapon; 1 EP; Licensed; +1,000 credits (the gun itself is bought normally).
Any character-scale ranged weapon can be added as a docking gun; it counts as a heavy weapon once installed, draws power from the ship, and has no effect on starship-scale combat.

rows.name: Superlasers
established: Printed only inside individual vehicle statblocks; every group is individually verified before it can be executable.

rows.name: Ion pulse cannons
established: Statblock equipment only; carries starship-scale radius with hit/miss riders.

rows.name: Droid jammer
established: Table 3-5: Special; 1 EP; Licensed; 8,000 credits. While employed, the starship's attacks gain a +2 equipment bonus to hit automated craft; affects only droid-controlled spacecraft within a 5-square radius.

rows.name: Harpoon gun
established: Statblock equipment only.

rows.name: Discord missiles and launcher
established: Matched to the canonical source; mechanics are effect-based (sensor jamming), not damage.

rows.name: Gravity mines and launcher
established: Prevent hyperspace jumps in an area (standard) or attach to a hull (magnetic); no damage.

rows.name: Chaff gun
established: Matched to the canonical source; availability not printed.

rows.name: Defoliator launcher and shell
established: Matched to the canonical source.

rows.name: Energy bomblet generator
established: Statblock equipment only.

rows.name: Heavy ordnance launcher
established: Statblock equipment only.

rows.name: Composite beam cannon
established: Ignores 5 points of the target's SR.

rows.name: Microtractor-pressor
established: Statblock equipment only.

rows.name: Anti-aircraft flak pod
established: An area attack even at starship scale: choose a 2x2 starship-scale area in range, attack Reflex Defense 10; on success compare the roll to each ship's Reflex; a hit deals damage, a miss half; Vehicular Evasion halves a hit and negates a miss.

rows.name: Proton grenade launcher and grenade
established: 3-square burst radius area attack: hit full damage, miss half.

rows.name: Cannon, double
established: Table 3-5: +1d10 damage; +0 EP; Licensed; cost x3.
Available for blasters, lasers, ion cannons and turbolasers (reciprocating multibarrel weapons); availability is the given one or the base weapon's, whichever is more restrictive.

rows.name: Cannon, triple
established: Functionally identical to double cannons (three slightly weaker cannons instead of two standard cannons); alias of the double row (census: sotg-cannon-triple).

rows.name: Cannon, quad
established: Table 3-5: +2d10 damage; +1 EP; Restricted; cost x5.

rows.name: Fire-linked weapons (2 and 4)
established: Table 3-5: fire-linked 2: +1d10, +1 EP, Licensed, x2; fire-linked 4: +2d10, +2 EP, Restricted, x4.

Weapons of any type that deal damage can be fire-linked. Fire-linked turbolasers are often described as batteries but this is not a weapon battery in game terms. Fire-linked missiles and torpedoes consume shots equal to the number of fire-linked launchers per attack.

rows.name: Fire-linked weapon, optional

sources.section: Weapon Systems: Fire-Linked Weapons (Optional Fire Link)

established: Table 3-5: +0 EP; Licensed; +1,000 credits. The link can be turned on or off as a swift action; the extra damage and ammunition consumption apply only while linked.

rows.name: Cannon enhancements and advanced cannon enhancements
established: Table 3-5: +1d10, +1 EP, Military, x2 / advanced +2d10, +2 EP, Military, x5.
Boost the damage of a blaster, a laser (but not a turbolaser) or an ion cannon.

rows.name: Weapon batteries (Core p. 170)
established: A battery of up to six identical weapons; full-battery mode with assistance and margin hits, or independent weapons; Aid Another between batteries (standard action, +2 per complete pair).
rows.nextSlice: stock done (P6C-2B/3); aftermarket batteries are not a purchasable component

rows.name: Point-defense weapon modification
established: Table 3-5: 0 EP (other than the weapon's own); Restricted; +4,000 credits per weapon; Colossal or larger only.
Normally only blaster cannons, laser cannons and light ion cannons can be point-defense weapons. A point-defense weapon takes no penalty for attacking targets smaller than Colossal.

rows.name: Autofire mode

sources.section: Weapon Systems: Cannon, Double/Quad; Fire-Linked Weapons (Autofire)
Special Combat Rules: Autofire; Vehicle Combat: Scale

established: Double, quad and fire-linked blaster cannons, laser cannons, light ion cannons and light turbolasers can fire normally or in autofire mode; a swift action switches between them. Larger ion cannons and turbolasers cannot autofire.
Core autofire: an area attack on a 2x2 area, one attack roll at -5 against every creature's Reflex; hit full damage, miss half; consumes ten shots.

Core vehicle combat: if a vehicle weapon is capable of autofire it can make an area attack at character scale; at starship scale area attacks (including autofire) resolve as attacks on a single target.

rows.name: Burst Fire (feat) on vehicle weapons

sources.section: Feats: Burst Fire; Special Combat Rules: Autofire

established: Burst Fire is a feat: autofire against a specific creature instead of an area at -5 attack for +2 dice of damage, using five shots; not an area attack.

rows.name: Launcher capacity upgrades

sources.section: Weapon Systems: Concussion Missiles / Proton Torpedoes / Shieldbuster Torpedoes / Space Mines (Launchers)

established: Capacity: concussion 6/16/30 (+20% per additional missile, up to double); proton torpedo launcher 3 (+25% per additional, up to 16); shieldbuster launcher 4 (+25%, up to 8); mine launcher 6 (+25%, up to 12).
